messages.subject: Error in rJava iniside map reduce function
parts:
Hi,

I made some custom R to Java function, which is working fine when I called it outside map-reduce function. But when I tried to called this java code inside map or reduce function. It throw error that class couldn't find.
Do I need to configure something, so that it can be working.

Here is a sample code

library(rJava)
 .jinit()

#####Function to calculate Timestamp from rowkey#################
##### GET base timestamp from rowkey, input as rawbytes
r2t.getBaseTimestamp <- function(rowkey)
{
    obj<-.jnew("DataType") ;
    res<-.jcall(obj,"I","getBaseTimestamp",rowkey);
}



####Map function to get key and mean(value)#######################
map1 <- expression({  
     result <- mapply(function(.index, k, r) {
        {
            sum <- sum + r
            count <- count+1 
        }
        }
      mean = sum/count   
   
    }, 1:length(map.keys), map.keys, map.values)

    k = r2t.getBaseTimestamp(map.keys[[1]])  ### R to Java function to calculate timestamp
    rhcollect(map.keys[[1]], result)   
})

Error:
Error in .jnew("DataType") : java.lang.ClassNotFoundException

I tried to copy this java file in HDFS too, it doesn't works. But if I call this function after map task then it is working. Even other simple hbase/hadoop java code is not working inside map/reduce function. It is most probably, because rJava is unable to load inside map function.

Thanks
Bikas

parts:
I agree with Saptarshi, always be suspicious of reading network folders on an actual cluster.  I have talked to IT support for a couple clusters before and they are always surprisingly okay with it, but it makes me nervous.  Hard to predict what kind of bottle-necking or denial of service or disk performance you will run into with reading from shared directories in MapReduce jobs.



You could zip up your jars and do a shared zip argument.  Check out rhwatch(..., shared="")

Shared itself is a thin wrapper for the hadoop DistributedCache system so it writes once per a node. 
http://hadoop.apache.org/docs/stable/api/org/apache/hadoop/filecache/DistributedCache.html
